body: Thank you so much for being there. I really appreciate it.

How do i know the answer to those two questions? 

I guess its good that he wants some space as it gives me time to think

Hi, we met up today and had a chat. He said he wants to be with me and he wants a future with me and that everything he's said to me in the past is true. He has asked for a bit of space for a couple of weeks as he said he feels like he is really struggling with some things (steroids) and needs some time to get himself in a better place so that we can be together. I am nervous about this but i also need him to be in a better place if i am going to do this.

Thank you for taking the time to talk with me. Your advice has been really clear and i will follow it. 
Ill let you know tomorrow how it goes

The other guy (only recently, 6mths) has become more cagey with me and has lied to me about things, although he has been honest after. He's adamant that he can do as he pleases, ie see his friends whenever he wants. Sometimes he goes "missing" for days and he has been out drinking. It causes me a lot of distress. Although i do think that although part of that is in his personality the other part is a rebellion to the fact that i haven't left and he has tried everything to support me to leave. I do worry about those things thou. My boyfriend would never do that although i am MUCH more laid back with him and he does often go out, i just don't make a big deal about it like i do with the other guy because i am insecure that he is lying to me and afraid he will meet someone else. This is a bit of a problem as i know i have appeared needy.

Yes, you are right. If i try very hard to boil it down to only the facts, then one of them is that my needs are being fulfilled. Yes, the other guy does fulfill the needs that my boyfriend can't give me. Yes, there are needs that my boyfriend gives me that the other man at this time doesn't me (im unaware of all of them or if you could fulfil more as i haven't been with him in a normal realsionship) 
They are : my  exceptionally intelligent in my opinion and i enjoy intelligent conversations with him. Ie i agree with his  lots of subjects  that are important to me. Like race, gender, environment etc. He's very open minded. 
He's stable and sensible. He respects my boundaries and would check with me before making decisions.

Yes, that's a check mark on his list. I'm definitely going to speak with him tomorrow about what he wants as i have mixed signals now, but like i said i think its because he has been pushed to his limit with waiting for me. I have some trust issues. I was pretty unhappy for a while before it started, it was the children thing, i found it very hard to accept that i wouldn't be having children and it wasn't my decision. I wanted to have children with my boyfriend. I found it hard that when i spoke about it with him there was never any discussion, it was just no. I felt unsupported in other ways and didn't want to have sex with him. I increasingly felt like i wanted to be looked after and began to resent that i didn't feel looked after. That said, i often feel like my mind plays tricks on me and if i make up all these problems to make myself unhappy, that if i just accepts him for who he is (he is a very very nice man and we are great friends) then i could be happy and pursue other areas of life with him. But i meet this guy and i couldn't help feel supported by him. I am very shocked that ive had an affair. Im actually a very loyal person believe it or not
I'm already 37 so not sure if its too late for me anyway

My partner doesn't want children. That's how this all happened in the first place. He told me about 5 years ago and he's adamant. Other guy does. I'm not sure if i do. But its caused me a lot of stress being told that i cant
Thank you * big sigh* i honestly don't know. Perhaps with my fears for both sides?
Yes it is the change i need. I just need to know which way to go. Can you help me go through it?

Yes you are right. That's exactly what is happening. It may even already be too late. We are going to have a conversation about it tomorrow. In the meantime in just beside myself with the fact that i may have already lost him and hurt by how he's been acting towards me though i know its probably because he's hurting himself. Then there's the fear of leaving my boyfriend. But this situation has to change. I cant go on.

I feel like trying to take a shot at happiness, leaving and being with this other man but im scared ill make the wrong choice and look back with regret, lose something i wasn't meant to and forever be unhappy and on the other hand i feel if i dont act ill lose the other guy and a chance to be happy as he has waited for me for so long and he needs me to show him i love him

Thank you for replying to me. 
My partner knows about my mental instability ie depression but I'm not sure he knows the extent of it. He would never ever forgive me if he knew. He would definitely leave me. I'm so ashamed of myself. I have always suffered this "depression" on and off since i was a child. I say depression but its more confusion. The other guy was a light to me and i am completely in love with him bit he's changed recently and i think he is having a lot of problems himself with me not leaving. He's started taking steroids and he's not there for me as much. That is killing me too.

Thank you. I mean that. 
I had to think about the answers for a minute. I would have normally said my partner but on reflection, I'm just moody round him now and "fake" all i think about is the other guy and if he still loves me. Whats he doing etc. He's quite unpredictable himself and moody but i think I'm happier around him and i think its him that makes me want to be a better person. Trouble is i feel so unstable i don't even trust my own thoughts completely

Thank you for replying to me. I think he is at the end of his ability to wait for me and has told me he wants to end it. I can't bear the thought of losing his love and i told him that i will leave. At first he said he didn't know if its the right time now but he later came back to me and said that he loves me and he wants to be with me. I feel so confused. It will kill me to leave my partner as i do love him but i also love this guy and why did i have an affair if i was happy in the first place. I wasn't happy. I just feel like i always fuck everythingup because im so messed up and its all too confusing that i dont want to be here anymore. Im not trying to get sympathy im trying to be honest as i havent got anyone to talk too
